comparison.objective: Arrange cots and pillows with prescribed spacing and alternating orientation; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-263 tests bimanual transport, layout, and cross-arm coordination; candidate tests hex-tool use, collar adjustment, locking, and physical response evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: PR-263 checks placement, spacing, alternation, and rejects stacked/tipped layouts; candidate checks two safe impact cycles and retained adjustment. No spec versions exist.
comparison.reason: Layout reasoning and placement do not test the candidate’s adjustment-and-lock commissioning ability.
